business_process: Field support: commissioning and event analysis
description: Substation visits for relay commissioning; retrieving and analyzing relay event records after a misoperation (on site or through the Client B gateway)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client B expects event analysis to start within one business day after a misoperation; a delayed answer keeps a 115 kV line or feeder in an abnormal setup; settings files change on site, so a day of work is the most that can be redone
manual_workaround: Client B technicians pull event records themselves and send them through the Client B file exchange; owner analyzes on the spare clean device; reschedule non-urgent commissioning
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-03; SYS-05; SYS-06 (Client B gateway)
dependent_third_parties: Client B; relay manufacturers (settings software); phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-engineer (single point of failure); client substations

description: Email and phone with clients; receiving and sending project files; the 24-hour incident notices that Client A and Client B require
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missed 24-hour notice breaks SSA-A (5) and VAA-B (5) and can delay a client's own CIP reporting; clients expect a same-day answer
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone; printed client contact sheet; client portals reached from the phone
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; phone carrier

description: Relay settings, coordination studies, and settings review packages for Client A and Client B; drawing markups for the drafting subcontractor
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Project milestones are set in weeks; settings databases change daily, so one day of rework is the tolerable loss. RPO of 24 hours is not supported today for local settings databases (no backup)
manual_workaround: Re-create settings from the last files delivered through the Client A portal; ask clients to move milestones
dependent_third_parties: Relay manufacturers (settings software); power system analysis software vendor; drafting subcontractor

description: Ten-year distribution planning study for Client C (load forecast and feeder analysis); interconnection study for Client D using FERC CEII
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Study deadlines are measured in weeks; CEII must stay in the encrypted archive during any recovery
manual_workaround: Pause the studies; tell Client C and Client D the new date
dependent_third_parties: Power system analysis software vendor; Client C; Client D

description: Invoicing, payments, bookkeeping, taxes, insurance, and contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $3,500 billed a week; clients pay in 30 days, so a week of delay costs little. A takeover of the accounting account could redirect payments
manual_workaround: Invoice from a document template by email; personal savings cover about two months of expenses
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS provider; bank; tax accountant
